name: kaafil
description: Kaafil AI-coding skills — teach your agent to integrate the kaafil-js SDK and the kaafil-react-uikit React components correctly, including the rules that invert the obvious default.

plugins.name: kaafil-skills
plugins.description: 21 skills covering the whole Kaafil integration — the React UI Kit's three persona surfaces, the browser and server halves of kaafil-js, and the backend lane that ingests trips and mints sessions. The /kaafil dispatcher detects your project, works out which persona you are building for, and routes. Every code sample is typechecked against the published packages in CI.
